Aurobindo Pharma signs a global licensing agreement with MSD for an investigational HIV prevention medicine.

Aurobindo Pharma has entered into a non-exclusive, royalty-free voluntary licensing agreement with MSD (Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, N.J., USA) for alimatravir, an investigational medicine for HIV prevention.

 - Aurobindo is among a select group of global generic manufacturers chosen to manufacture and supply generic alimatravir.
 - The agreement covers 129 low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), which account for the majority of new HIV diagnoses globally.
 - Notably, the licensing agreements have been executed before the completion of Phase 3 clinical trials, a first in HIV prevention. This is intended to enable faster manufacturing scale-up if the medicine receives regulatory approval.

While commercialization remains subject to successful clinical development and regulatory approvals, the agreement reinforces Aurobindo Pharma's position as a trusted global partner for expanding access to affordable medicines.

For investors, the announcement is strategically important as it strengthens the company's presence in the global access and infectious disease space, while also highlighting its manufacturing and regulatory capabilities.

Ice Make Refrigeration announces a strategic partnership with Japan's Galilei to fuel its next phase of growth.

Ice Make Refrigeration has signed definitive agreements with Galilei Holdings Co. Ltd., a company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, covering a strategic investment, shareholder partnership, and a manufacturing joint venture.

Here's what stood out 
 
₹190 Cr fund raise
 - ₹180 Cr to be invested by Galilei through a preferential issue of equity shares.
 - An additional ₹10 Cr will be raised from other investors.

Joint Venture with Galilei
A new JV will be established with:
 - Galilei: 60% stake
 - Ice Make Refrigeration: 40% stake
The JV will focus on manufacturing and marketing commercial upright refrigerators, commercial table refrigerators, and related refrigeration products.

 Strengthening growth capabilities
The fresh capital will be used for:
 - Capacity expansion
 - Modernisation of existing facilities
 - Scaling integrated refrigeration and cold-room solutions

Investment in the JV
 - Setting up a new corporate office, Centre of Excellence, and advanced R&D/testing laboratory
 - Repayment/prepayment of existing borrowings to strengthen the balance sheet

Strategic optionality
The company also plans to evaluate select acquisitions in the refrigeration, cold-chain, and allied sectors to expand its market presence and technology capabilities.

This is more than a capital raise. The combination of strategic capital from a global refrigeration player, a manufacturing JV, and a clear roadmap for capacity expansion, R&D, debt reduction, and potential acquisitions makes this a noteworthy development.

Summary: Chinese AI models now account for approximately 58% of AI token usage by U.S. firms on OpenRouter, surpassing U.S. models for the first time. The shift underscores the rapid adoption of low-cost, high-performance Chinese models such as DeepSeek and Qwen, intensifying competitive pressure on U.S. AI leaders. The data reflects usage on OpenRouter and not the overall global AI market.

DUBAI RESIDENTS CAN EARN OVER DH3,000 AND TRAVEL REWARDS THROUGH REFERRAL PROGRAM

Dubai residents can earn more than Dh3,000 in rewards, along with additional travel benefits, by referring family and friends to visit Dubai under eligible tourism referral programs. Rewards may include cash-equivalent benefits, airline miles, hotel points, or travel vouchers, depending on the specific campaign.

INDIA’S GEM & JEWELLERY EXPORTS JUMP 26.5% IN JUNE TO $2.21 BILLION

India’s gem and jewellery exports rose 26.5% year-on-year to $2.21 billion in June, indicating a strong recovery in overseas demand after a weak base and improving export orders.

LPG TANKER ATTACKED IN IRANIAN WATERS; 28 INDIAN CREW SAFE

An LPG tanker carrying 28 Indian crew members was reportedly attacked in Iranian waters, but all crew are safe, according to initial reports. The incident highlights persistent security risks for commercial shipping in the region and could further elevate concerns over maritime safety and energy supply routes amid ongoing Middle East tensions.

32GB RAM NOW COSTS AS MUCH AS A 16GB MACBOOK PRO

Memory prices have surged so sharply that 32GB of RAM now costs roughly as much as an Apple MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM. The spike reflects a sharp rise in DRAM prices driven by AI-driven demand, tighter supply, and manufacturers prioritizing high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI servers, increasing costs for PC makers, enterprise buyers, and consumers upgrading systems.

AUROBINDO PHARMA: SIGNS VOLUNTARY LICENSING DEAL WITH MSD FOR HIV PREVENTION DRUG 🌍💊

• 🤝 Aurobindo Pharma has signed a non-exclusive, royalty-free voluntary licensing agreement with MSD (Merck & Co.)

• 🦠 Agreement allows Aurobindo to manufacture and supply generic alimatravir, an investigational HIV prevention medicine, subject to regulatory approvals

• 🌎 Generic alimatravir will be supplied to 129 Low- & Middle-Income Countries (LMICs), covering the majority of new HIV diagnoses globally

• 🚀 The agreement has been signed before completion of Phase 3 trials, enabling early manufacturing scale-up once approvals are received

• 🏭 Aurobindo is among a select group of global generic manufacturers chosen under the licensing program

🟢 Impact: Positive. The agreement strengthens Aurobindo's global CDMO/generics positioning, expands its infectious disease portfolio, and creates a long-term opportunity in HIV prevention markets after regulatory approvals.

HINDUSTAN FOODS: SUBSIDIARY TEMPORARILY HALTS SILVASSA OPERATIONS DUE TO FLOODING 🌧️🏭

• ⚠️ Hindustan Foods' subsidiary Aero Care Personal Products LLP has temporarily suspended operations at its Silvassa manufacturing facilities due to flooding caused by incessant rainfall and severe waterlogging. 

• 🛠️ The company is assessing the extent of damage to plant, machinery, inventory and other assets. The financial impact cannot yet be quantified as access to certain areas remains restricted. 

• 🛡️ The affected assets are comprehensively covered under insurance, and the company has initiated measures to safeguard assets and restore operations at the earliest. 

• 📅 The company expects operations to gradually normalize over the next few days, subject to weather conditions, while the loss assessment is underway. 

🟡 Impact: Neutral (The disruption is temporary and insured, but the financial impact remains uncertain until the damage assessment is completed.)

ULTRATECH CEMENT: CARE ASSIGNS AAA RATING TO ₹5,000 CRORE NCD ISSUE ⭐🏗️

• 🏦 CARE Ratings has assigned 'CARE AAA; Stable' rating to UltraTech Cement's proposed ₹5,000 crore Non-Convertible Debenture (NCD) issue and reaffirmed 'CARE AAA; Stable / CARE A1+' ratings on its existing bank facilities.  

• 🏭 CARE highlighted UltraTech's market leadership, with 205.5 MTPA global cement capacity, and expects the company to expand capacity to over 242.5 MTPA by FY28-end. 

• 🌱 The company is targeting 85% of its power requirement from green energy by FY30, with renewable capacity planned to rise from 1.39 GW to 2 GW by FY27-end. 

• 💪 CARE also cited UltraTech's strong financial profile, healthy liquidity, robust cash flows and comfortable leverage, while noting exposure to cement industry cyclicality and input cost volatility as key monitorable factors. 

🟢 Impact: Positive (The reaffirmation of the highest credit rating and AAA rating for the proposed NCD issue reflects UltraTech's strong balance sheet, market leadership and financial strength.)

Iran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz appears to have dealt far greater damage to its own trade with China than to Beijing's commerce with the rest of the Persian Gulf, according to newly released Chinese customs data.

Between March and June 2026, Iran's non-oil trade with China totaled just $830 million, down from $3.3 billion during the same period last year—a decline of roughly 75%.

Kpler shipping data reviewed by Iran International also point to a sharp decline in Iranian oil exports to China. 

Average daily unloadings at Chinese ports fell from 1.74 million barrels per day in April to around 550,000 barrels per day in the first half of July.

Together, the figures suggest the Strait of Hormuz closure has dealt a severe blow to Iran's economic ties with its largest trading partner.

EPIGRAL is quietly repositioning itself beyond chlor-alkali

New subsidiary just floated

- Epigral Advanced Materials Limited incorporated on July 7, 2026

- 100% subsidiary of Epigral Limited

- Mandate: push into high-value downstream specialty chemistries across pharma, agrochemicals and electronics

This isn't a surprise if you read the FY26 annual report

- Company had already flagged a 100 acre land parcel at Dahej for what management called "new chemistry development"

- In the AR, they said this signals a growth plan beyond FY27-28, strictly downstream to existing derivatives

- They also said they'd share specifics only once project scope was finalized - this new entity looks like that formalization

Core capex cycle is still running in parallel

- CPVC Resin capacity being scaled from 75,000 TPA to 1,50,000 TPA

- Epichlorohydrin (ECH) capacity being doubled from 50,000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA

- Both expected to commission by Q2 FY27

- Chlorotoluene value chain facility already commissioned but still in customer approval and ramp up phase, not yet showing up meaningfully in the P&L

- Consolidated capex in FY26 stood at ₹394 Cr, net debt/EBITDA comfortable at 0.9x

Where the new subsidiary fits

- Management has guided Derivative and Specialty products to reach ~70% of revenue by FY28

- The new subsidiary extends that shift beyond the existing basket into entirely new chemistries

- Core thesis is import substitution - cutting dependence on imported high end chemical products

- Balance sheet stays conservative enough (net debt/equity at 0.2x) to fund this without stretching leverage

FY26 was a soft year on realisations and volumes, but the direction of capital allocation hasn't changed. 

If anything, the new entity confirms the next leg of the growth story is already being built.

Waiting for the concall on 27th July for further details on the new entity.
